title: Predict Invalidated Payload (v1) — Predict-invalidated-plane entity
description: Phase 16 — Cascade invalidation events (Phase 13.51). Per EMITTER.md cross-phase alignment, predict.invalidated.v1 is both a control-plane bus topic AND a feed. The emitter writes both under a single transactional barrier.

prediction_id.description: Unique identifier of the prediction being invalidated.

affected_match_ids.description: Match IDs affected by this invalidation event.

invalidated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the invalidation was triggered.
